\subsection*{Phylogenetic analyses}

We analysed 12 taxa and 898 aligned sites (nucleotide; partition ``gene1``) and 12 taxa and 898 aligned sites (nucleotide; partition ``gene2``). 
Substitution and clock models were specified as a hky \citep{hasegawa1985}$+\Gamma_{4}$ substitution model with a strict \citep{zuckerkandl1965} clock and a hky \citep{hasegawa1985}$+\Gamma_{4}$ substitution model with a strict \citep{zuckerkandl1965} clock. 
A Yule \citep{yule1925} tree prior was assumed. 
Node calibrations were assigned as standard calibration densities \citep{drummond2006relaxed, ho2009calibration}: 
\begin{center}\small
\begin{tabular}{llll}
\toprule
Calibration & Distribution & Parameters & Source \\
\midrule
Catarrhini & lognormal & mean=1.0, meanInRealSpace=True, stdev=0.5 & fossil \\
Homininae & lognormal & mean=1.0, meanInRealSpace=True, stdev=0.5 & literature \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}

MCMC analyses were run for 2000000 states, sampling every 1000 states (2000 samples) with an automatically adapted operator scheme \citep{drummond2007beast}. 
Analyses were configured with BeastXPy v0.1.0 and targeted BEAST v10.5.0 \citep{drummond2007beast, drummond2012beast}. 
All XML input files passed the BeastXPy validation pipeline (configuration-, structure- and calibration-gates, plus BEAST 10.5.0 parser instantiation). 
The analysis fingerprint is \texttt{BXP-a40cdff055ca-0.1.0} (data digest \texttt{909f6337667a2684}).
